test_cases.test_case: Successful login with valid credentials
test_cases.expected_result: authenticates and redirects to Product Inventory page

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Username field blank and submit
steps: 2. Enter <valid password> in the Password field
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Username field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Password field blank and submit
steps: 1. Enter <valid username> in the Username field
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Password field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Submit with both fields empty
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Username field indicating it is required; Inline validation error appears on the Password field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Submit with invalid credentials
steps: 1. Enter <invalid username> in the Username field
2. Enter <invalid password> in the Password field
test_cases.expected_result: Page displays 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service.'

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to login with locked out user
steps: 1. Enter locked_out_user in the Username field
2. Enter secret_sauce in the Password field
test_cases.expected_result: Page displays 'Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.'

test_cases.test_case: Username field is empty
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays: 'Epic sadface: Username is required.'

test_cases.test_case: Password field is empty
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays: 'Epic sadface: Password is required.'

test_cases.test_case: Invalid credentials with valid username
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays: 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service.'

test_cases.test_case: Attempt login with locked out user
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays: 'Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.'

test_cases.test_case: Enter long username
steps: 1. Enter a very long string (over 100 characters) in the Username field
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays: 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service.'

test_cases.test_case: Enter special characters in username
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays: 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service.'

test_cases.test_case: Leading/trailing whitespace in username
steps: 1. Enter ' standard_user ' (with spaces) in the Username field
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays: 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service.'

test_cases.test_case: View product detail
steps: 1. Click on a product name or image in the Product List
test_cases.expected_result: Product Detail page is displayed with the selected product information

test_cases.test_case: Add item to cart
steps: 1. Click 'Add to cart' button for a product
test_cases.expected_result: The button changes to 'Remove' and the cart badge count updates accordingly

test_cases.test_case: Remove item from cart
steps: 1. Click 'Remove' button for the product in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: The item is removed from the cart

test_cases.test_case: Sort products by name A-Z
test_cases.expected_result: Products are sorted in alphabetical order from A to Z

test_cases.test_case: Sort products by price low-high
test_cases.expected_result: Products are sorted in ascending order by price

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to add a product to cart without being logged in
steps: 1. Navigate to the Product Inventory page
2. Click 'Add to cart' for any product
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to remove a product from cart without being logged in
steps: 1. Navigate to the Product Inventory page
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Rapidly add and remove a product from the cart
preconditions: User is logged in and on the Product Inventory page
steps: 1. Click 'Add to cart' on a product
2. Immediately click 'Remove' on the same product
test_cases.expected_result: 'Remove' action succeeds; the product is removed from the cart and the cart badge count updates accordingly.

test_cases.test_case: Sort products using special characters
preconditions: User is logged in and on the Product Inventory page
test_cases.expected_result: Products are sorted alphabetically from A to Z; the first product in the list starts with the letter A.

test_cases.test_case: Sort products using a long name
preconditions: User is logged in and on the Product Inventory page
test_cases.expected_result: Products are sorted by price in descending order; the highest priced product appears at the top of the list.

test_cases.test_case: Add product to cart
test_cases.expected_result: The button changes to 'Remove' and the product is now in the cart

test_cases.test_case: Remove product from cart
test_cases.expected_result: The button changes to 'Add to cart' and the product is no longer in the cart

test_cases.test_case: Navigate back to products
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the Product Inventory page

test_cases.test_case: Navigate to shopping cart
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the Shopping Cart page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to remove a product that is not in the cart
preconditions: Product is not in the cart
steps: 1. Navigate to the Product Detail page
test_cases.expected_result: No action occurs; 'Remove' button is not available

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to add a product that is already in the cart
preconditions: Product is already in the cart
steps: 1. Navigate to the Product Detail page
2. Click on the 'Add to cart' button
test_cases.expected_result: No action occurs; 'Add to cart' button is not available

test_cases.test_case: Rapid consecutive state transitions from Not In Cart to In Cart
preconditions: Product is currently Not In Cart
test_cases.expected_result: Both actions are processed successfully; the product is removed from the cart.

test_cases.test_case: Rapid consecutive state transitions from In Cart to Not In Cart
test_cases.expected_result: Both actions are processed successfully; the product is added back to the cart.

test_cases.test_case: Back navigation after adding to cart
test_cases.expected_result: User is navigated to the Shopping Cart without duplication of the product.

test_cases.test_case: Remove an item from the cart
steps: 1. Click the 'Remove' button for an item in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: The item is no longer visible in the cart

test_cases.test_case: Continue shopping from the cart
test_cases.expected_result: returns to Product Inventory

test_cases.test_case: Begin checkout from the cart
test_cases.expected_result: begins checkout

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to remove an item from an empty cart
steps: 1. Ensure the shopping cart is empty
2. Click the 'Remove' button for an item
test_cases.expected_result: No action occurs; the cart remains empty and no item is removed

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to checkout with an empty cart
steps: 1. Ensure the shopping cart is empty
test_cases.expected_result: No action occurs; the checkout process does not begin

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to continue shopping with an empty cart
steps: 1. Ensure the shopping cart is empty
test_cases.expected_result: No action occurs; the user remains on the Shopping Cart page

test_cases.test_case: Rapidly click 'Continue Shopping' after adding an item
preconditions: User has added an item to the cart
test_cases.expected_result: 'Continue Shopping' redirects to Product Inventory without duplicating the item in the cart.

test_cases.test_case: Rapidly click 'Checkout' after adding an item
preconditions: User has added an item to the cart
test_cases.expected_result: Checkout process begins without any errors or duplicate entries.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to remove an item from an empty cart
steps: 1. Attempt to click 'Remove' button for a non-existent item
test_cases.expected_result: No action occurs; a message indicates the cart is empty.

test_cases.test_case: Submit the checkout information form with valid data
steps: 1. Enter <valid first name> in the First Name field
2. Enter <valid last name> in the Last Name field
3. Enter <valid zip/postal code> in the Zip/Postal Code field
test_cases.expected_result: User proceeds to the overview step

test_cases.test_case: Cancel the checkout information form
test_cases.expected_result: User returns to the Shopping Cart

test_cases.test_case: Leave the First Name field blank and submit
steps: 2. Fill Last_Name and Zip_Postal_Code with valid data
test_cases.expected_result: Error: First Name is required is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Last Name field blank and submit
steps: 2. Fill First_Name and Zip_Postal_Code with valid data
test_cases.expected_result: Error: Last Name is required is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Zip/Postal Code field blank and submit
steps: 2. Fill First_Name and Last_Name with valid data
test_cases.expected_result: Error: Postal Code is required is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Submit with all required fields empty
steps: 1. Leave the First_Name, Last_Name, and Zip_Postal_Code fields blank
test_cases.expected_result: Error: First Name is required, Error: Last Name is required, and Error: Postal Code is required are displayed

test_cases.test_case: Submit form with First Name empty
steps: 1. Leave the First Name field empty
2. Fill in the Last Name field with 'Doe'
3. Fill in the Zip/Postal Code field with '12345'
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays: 'Error: First Name is required'

test_cases.test_case: Submit form with Last Name empty
steps: 1. Fill in the First Name field with 'John'
2. Leave the Last Name field empty
3. Fill in the Zip/Postal Code field with '12345'
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays: 'Error: Last Name is required'

test_cases.test_case: Submit form with Zip/Postal Code empty
steps: 1. Fill in the First Name field with 'John'
2. Fill in the Last Name field with 'Doe'
3. Leave the Zip/Postal Code field empty
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays: 'Error: Postal Code is required'

test_cases.test_case: Submit form with long First Name
steps: 1. Enter a very long string (200+ characters) in the First Name field
2. Fill in the Last Name field with 'Doe'
3. Fill in the Zip/Postal Code field with '12345'
test_cases.expected_result: Form submits successfully; entity is created with the long First Name

test_cases.test_case: Submit form with special characters in Last Name
steps: 1. Fill in the First Name field with 'John'
2. Enter special characters in the Last Name field (e.g., '!@#$%^&*()')
3. Fill in the Zip/Postal Code field with '12345'
test_cases.expected_result: Form submits successfully; entity is created with the special characters in Last Name

test_cases.test_case: Complete the order successfully
preconditions: Order items are present in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: completes the order and navigates to the confirmation page

test_cases.test_case: Cancel the checkout process
preconditions: Order items are present in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: exits checkout

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to finish checkout without providing payment information
steps: 1. Leave the Payment Information section blank
test_cases.expected_result: Form does not submit; error shown on Payment Information field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to finish checkout without providing shipping information
steps: 1. Leave the Shipping Information section blank
test_cases.expected_result: Form does not submit; error shown on Shipping Information field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to finish checkout with empty order summary
steps: 1. Ensure the Order Summary is empty
test_cases.expected_result: Form does not submit; error shown on Order Summary field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to finish checkout with empty totals section
steps: 1. Ensure the Totals Section is empty
test_cases.expected_result: Form does not submit; error shown on Totals Section field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Enter a very long string in the Order Summary field
steps: 1. Enter a string of 200+ characters in the Order Summary field
test_cases.expected_result: Order Summary field accepts the input or displays an error indicating the input is too long

test_cases.test_case: Enter special characters in the Payment Information field
steps: 1. Enter special characters (e.g., !@#$%^&*) in the Payment Information field
test_cases.expected_result: Payment Information field accepts the input or displays a specific error message

test_cases.test_case: Enter leading and trailing whitespace in the Shipping Information field
steps: 1. Enter '   123 Main St   ' in the Shipping Information field
test_cases.expected_result: Leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed; saved value shown in detail page has no extra spaces

test_cases.test_case: Display success message on confirmation page
test_cases.expected_result: The page displays 'Thank you for your order!'

test_cases.test_case: Return to Product Inventory from confirmation page
test_cases.expected_result: returns to Product Inventory and clears the cart

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to access the confirmation page without completing the checkout process
steps: 1. Navigate to the confirmation page directly
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the checkout process; confirmation page is not displayed

test_cases.test_case: Enter a long success message
steps: 1. Enter a very long string (over 200 characters) in the Success_Message field
test_cases.expected_result: The system displays a truncated version of the success message, indicating it has exceeded the character limit.

test_cases.test_case: Enter special characters in the success message
steps: 1. Enter a success message containing special characters (e.g., @#$%^&*()!)
test_cases.expected_result: The system accepts the special characters and displays the success message correctly.

test_cases.test_case: Enter leading and trailing whitespace in the success message
steps: 1. Enter a success message with leading and trailing spaces
test_cases.expected_result: The system trims the whitespace and displays the success message without extra spaces.

test_cases.test_case: User successfully logs out
test_cases.expected_result: ends the session and redirects to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to logout while not logged in
test_cases.expected_result: Logout action is blocked; user remains on the current page and is not redirected to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Reset App State clears the cart and resets UI elements
steps: 1. Click the Reset App State Button
test_cases.expected_result: The cart is cleared; the cart badge state is reset; the add/remove button states are reset

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to reset app state without any items in the cart
steps: 2. Click on the Reset App State Button
test_cases.expected_result: No changes occur; the cart remains empty and the cart badge state is unchanged

test_cases.test_case: Rapid consecutive clicks on Reset App State button
preconditions: User is logged in and has items in the cart
steps: 1. Click the Reset App State button
2. Immediately click the Reset App State button again
test_cases.expected_result: The cart is cleared; the cart badge state resets; the add/remove button states reset without any error shown.

test_cases.test_case: Click Reset App State button after clearing the cart
preconditions: User is logged in and has already cleared the cart
steps: 1. Click the Reset App State button
test_cases.expected_result: The cart remains empty; the cart badge state resets; the add/remove button states reset without any error shown.
